files.content:
# Backlog — Sprint Candidate Queue

## BL-108: Add `--json` flag to `report export`
The export command currently prints a fixed table to stdout. Add a `--json`
flag that emits the same rows as a JSON array. The row objects already exist
internally (`ReportRow` dataclass in `reporting/rows.py`); the table renderer
is the only consumer today. No schema decisions open — field names mirror the
dataclass. One integration test to add alongside the existing table test.

## BL-112: Replace the session store with Postgres
Sessions live in a single-process in-memory dict today (`server/session.py`,
~200 lines) and are lost on restart. Move to Postgres so sessions survive
restarts and so the second app instance can serve the same users.

Unknowns noted in the thread:
- Nobody has confirmed whether the ops team can provision a Postgres instance
  for this service or whether we share the billing cluster.
- Session objects hold arbitrary pickled payloads today; what a relational
  schema looks like has not been worked out.
- The logout/expiry semantics were never written down — current behaviour is
  "whatever the dict does".
- Cutover with zero forced re-login has been requested but not designed.

## BL-115: Fix timezone drift in the daily digest email
The digest sends at 07:00 UTC instead of 07:00 local for the ~40 non-UTC
accounts. `scheduler/digest.py` builds the send time with `datetime.utcnow()`
and ignores `account.timezone`, which is already stored and populated. Fix is
in one function; there is an existing test file for the scheduler with a
frozen-clock helper.

## BL-121: Onboarding wizard for new workspaces
New workspaces land on an empty dashboard. Build a guided multi-step wizard
covering: invite teammates, connect a data source, pick a starter template.

Open threads:
- Product has sketched three steps but has not signed off on the order or on
  whether steps are skippable.
- The connectors list is being reworked in parallel by another team; the
  wizard would consume whatever that lands on.
- Needs new persistence for "wizard progress" — no store exists.
- Design has not started; copy for each step is unwritten.
